svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
the table's alphabets unknown: with no move and a key of 7, each slot needs its own one-to-one swap of letters (message to carved)
slot 2: R and C both become P; slot 3: T and L both become V, A and K both become K. No swap does that: no move fails
after a move the slots regroup; equations mod 2 and mod 13 then test one alphabet (III) or a pair (IV) with the key as shifts
settings that fit, out of 27,853 moves; in brackets the lowest and highest of ten scrambled coppers; accent where outside
OUT: NO READING; ONE MARGINAL EXCESS, AT PERIOD 3
